2115914958408192187.en_summary: (Reposted by @RedDogT3) Intel $INTC CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Nova Lake: “Nova Lake, our first Intel 18A-P client product, is tracking ahead of schedule.” Intel expects Nova Lake to have twice as many design wins as Panther Lake at launch. 2115914722927399139.en_summary: (Reposted by @RedDogT3) $INTC CEO outlined three headwinds limiting its ability to meet strong server CPU demand: 1. Intel 3 yields and cycle times are improving, but more work is needed. 2. Industry-wide shortages of advanced organic substrates for EMIB packaging are constraining output. 3. An accident at its Israel factory caused an extended shutdown, which will impact Q4 server shipments.
2115914722927399139.zh_summary: （由@RedDogT3轉推）INTC首席執行官概述了限制其滿足強勁伺服器CPU需求能力的三個逆風：1. Intel 3良率和週期時間正在改善，但還需更多工作。2. EMIB封裝先進有機基板的行業範圍短缺正在限制產出。3. 以色列工廠事故導致延長關閉，將影響第四季伺服器出貨。

ticker_notes.INTC: 伺服器CPU需求強但受良率、基板短缺及以色列工廠關閉限制，影響Q4出貨

2115914513623154758.en_summary: $SNDK says “demand from our customers is growing faster than our supply” with data center NAND demand expected to grow ~40% in 2027. And with two-thirds of FY2028 supply already committed under multi-year deals carrying ~$94B in minimum revenue commitments it makes you wonder if the traditional NAND cycle is starting to change. (Quoted earnings: Revenue $11.0B vs Est. $10.6B, EPS $49.51 vs Est. $46.22, etc., and 8-for-1 stock split)
2115914513623154758.zh_summary: SNDK表示「客戶需求增長快於供應」，數據中心NAND需求預期2027年增長約40%。且FY2028供應的三分之二已在多年協議下承諾，最低收入承諾約940億美元，令人懷疑傳統NAND週期是否開始改變。（引用盈利：營收110億美元對估計106億，EPS 49.51對估計46.22等，以及8對1股票拆分）

ticker_notes.SNDK: 需求快於供應，2027年數據中心NAND增長約40%，FY2028供應大部分已承諾，最低收入約940億美元
